items.source: Conveniently, forReadOnlyDataBinding() enables read-only access to properties via DataBindingPropertyAccessor. Similarly, forReadWriteDataBinding() enables read and write access to properties. Alternatively, configure custom accessors via forPropertyAccessors(PropertyAccessor...), potentially disable assignment, and optionally activate method resolution and/or a type converter through the builder.
items.translation: 方便地，forReadOnlyDataBinding() 可通过 DataBindingPropertyAccessor 实现属性的只读访问。同样，forReadWriteDataBinding() 可实现属性的读写访问。或者，通过 forPropertyAccessors(PropertyAccessor...) 配置自定义访问器，可能 禁用赋值，并可选地通过构建器激活方法解析和/或类型转换器。

items.source: Note that SimpleEvaluationContext is typically not configured with a default root object. Instead it is meant to be created once and used repeatedly through getValue calls on a predefined Expression with both an EvaluationContext and a root object as arguments: Expression.getValue(EvaluationContext, Object).
items.translation: 请注意，`SimpleEvaluationContext` 通常不配置默认根对象。相反，它旨在创建一次，并通过预定义的Expression上的getValue调用重复使用，该表达式接受EvaluationContext和根对象作为参数：Expression.getValue(EvaluationContext, Object)。

items.source: In addition to support for setting and looking up variables as defined in the EvaluationContext API, SimpleEvaluationContext also provides support for registering and looking up functions as variables. Since functions share a common namespace with the variables in this evaluation context, care must be taken to ensure that function names and variable names do not overlap.
items.translation: 除了支持在 EvaluationContext API 中定义的设置和查找变量外，SimpleEvaluationContext 还支持注册和查找函数作为变量。由于函数与此评估上下文中的变量共享公共命名空间，因此必须小心确保函数名称和变量名称不重叠。

items.source: A function can be registered as a Method or a MethodHandle.
items.translation: 函数可以注册为 `Method` 或 `MethodHandle`。

items.source: By default, assignment is enabled within expressions evaluated by the context created via this factory method. Assignment can be disabled via SimpleEvaluationContext.Builder.withAssignmentDisabled(); however, it is preferable to use forReadOnlyDataBinding() if you desire read-only access.
items.translation: 默认情况下，通过此工厂方法创建的上下文会在表达式中启用赋值。可以通过 SimpleEvaluationContext.Builder.withAssignmentDisabled() 禁用赋值；但是，如果您希望仅进行只读访问，则更推荐使用 forReadOnlyDataBinding()。

items.source: For more power and flexibility, in particular for internal configuration scenarios, consider using StandardEvaluationContext instead.
items.translation: 为了获得更大的功能和灵活性，特别是在内部配置场景中，请考虑使用StandardEvaluationContext。

items.source: By default this is StandardTypeConverter.
items.translation: 默认情况下，这是StandardTypeConverter。

items.source: By default, assignment is enabled within expressions evaluated by the context created via this factory method; however, assignment can be disabled via SimpleEvaluationContext.Builder.withAssignmentDisabled().
items.translation: 默认情况下，通过此工厂方法创建的上下文会在表达式中启用赋值；但是，可以通过 SimpleEvaluationContext.Builder.withAssignmentDisabled() 禁用赋值。

items.source: In many cases, the full extent of the SpEL language is not required and should be meaningfully restricted. Examples include but are not limited to data binding expressions, property-based filters, and others. To that effect, SimpleEvaluationContext is tailored to support only a subset of the SpEL language syntax, for example, excluding references to Java types, constructors, and bean references.
items.translation: 在许多情况下，并不需要 SpEL 语言的全部功能，而应对其进行有意义的限制。示例包括但不限于数据绑定表达式、基于属性的过滤器等。为此，`SimpleEvaluationContext` 专为支持 SpEL 语言语法的一个子集而设计，例如，排除了对 Java 类型、构造函数和 Bean 引用等的引用。
